stem: Which graph shows a proportional relationship between x and y?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with line passing through origin going from bottom-left to top-right

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with line passing through (0,-1) going from top-left to bottom-right

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with line passing through origin going from bottom-left to top-right

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with horizontal line at y=0

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled F, H, G, J each with coordinate grid and line shown
notes: Graphs F and G show lines through origin, but typically only one correct proportional graph is expected, usually with positive slope.
